name: Leveling
description: Members get a chat level for chatting and a separate voice level for talking in voice. Both add up to an overall level that ranks the live leaderboard.

defaults.title: {track} level up!
defaults.description: {user} just reached **{track} level {level}**. Keep it up!

levels.title: Three levels
levels.name: {label} level
levels.textHelp: Only from messages in text channels.
levels.voiceHelp: Only from time spent talking in voice channels.
levels.overallHelp: Chat XP + voice XP together. The leaderboard is ranked by it.

form.enabledHelp: Members start earning XP right away. Bots never earn XP.

sourceHints.both: A chat level, a voice level and an overall level from both.
sourceHints.text: Only the chat level. Time in voice earns nothing.
sourceHints.voice: Only the voice level. Messages earn nothing.

form.rulesText: Chat XP: {min}–{max} per message, at most once a minute.
form.rulesVoice: Voice XP: at most {cap} a day, spread over {hours} hours of talking with at least one other person (about {voice} a minute). Muted or deafened members and the AFK channel earn nothing.
form.rulesBoth: Chat and voice level up separately.
form.ignoredHelp: Text or voice channels, or whole categories. Threads follow their channel.

announceModesHelp.current: Chat level ups go to the channel the member wrote in, voice level ups to the text chat of their voice channel. No channel to pick.
announceModesHelp.channel: Every level up goes to the channel below.
announceModesHelp.off: Members still level up, there is just no message.

form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.
form.mentionHelp: Pings the member above the embed so they get a notification.
form.leaderboardHelp: A message with the top members that ShifuBot keeps up to date. Leave the channel empty for no panel.
form.intervalHelp: The panel is only edited when something changed, so a short interval is fine.

placeholder.level: The new chat or voice level
placeholder.track: Which level went up: Chat or Voice

list.overallHint: overall level = chat XP + voice XP
list.notOnList: You are not on this list yet. Chat or talk in voice to earn XP.
list.empty: Nobody has XP yet. Start chatting!

leaderboard.title: {server} leaderboard
leaderboard.legend: {overall} level = chat XP + voice XP. Ranked by total XP.
leaderboard.empty: Nobody has XP yet. Start chatting!

rank.title: {username}'s rank
rank.disabled: Leveling is turned off on this server.

status.noAnnounceChannel: Pick a channel for level up messages.
status.channelMissing: A selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.panelMissing: The leaderboard is not posted. Save, or post it again below.

panel.failed: Settings saved, but the leaderboard could not be updated: {error}
panel.help: Use this if someone deleted the leaderboard message.

top.resetBody: Every member of this server goes back to chat level 0 and voice level 0. This cannot be undone.
top.openListHelp: Every member of the server can open it after signing in with Discord.

preview.levelUpHint: Shown with your name at level 5.
preview.leaderboardHint: With the real top members of this server.

setup.title: Leveling
setup.description: Reward active members with XP and levels. Fine tune messages and the leaderboard later on the Leveling page.

manager.disabled: Leveling is turned off, so nobody earns XP right now. You can still correct XP here.
manager.empty: Nobody has XP yet. Search for a name to give someone XP by hand.
manager.emptyLeft: None of the members who left have XP.
manager.othersHint: They have no XP yet. Pick one to give them some.

editor.help: A correction sends no level up message. The leaderboard panel follows on its next refresh.
editor.levelHelp: The member starts at the beginning of that level.
editor.tooBig: That is too much. The most you can enter is {max}.
editor.clampedZero: They only have {xp} XP, so they end up at 0.
editor.clampedMax: A member can have at most {max} XP, so it stops there.
editor.previewEmpty: Enter an amount to see the result.
editor.resetBody: Their chat XP, voice XP, message count and voice minutes go back to 0. This cannot be undone.
